sub_questions.text_english: Reena and Teena were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2: 1. Teena withdrew ₹ 20,000 at the beginning of each month during the year ended 31st March, 2025. Interest on drawings was to be charged @ 6% per annum. Interest on Teena's drawings for the year ended 31st March, 2025 will be :
sub_questions.solution: Option A is correct because Teena withdrew twenty thousand rupees at the beginning of each month, making her total drawings two lakh forty thousand rupees. The average period for drawings made at the beginning of each month is six and a half months, so the interest is calculated as two lakh forty thousand multiplied by six percent and six point five over twelve, which gives seven thousand eight hundred rupees.

sub_questions.text: रोहन तथा सोहन एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा लाभ-हानि बराबर-बराबर बाँटते थे । 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में रोहन ने प्रत्येक तिमाही के शुरू में ₹ 15,000 का आहरण किया । रोहन के आहरण पर कितनी औसत अवधि के लिए ब्याज की गणना की जाएगी ?
sub_questions.text_english: Rohan and Sohan were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses equally. Rohan withdrew ₹15,000 at the beginning of each quarter during the year ended 31st March, 2025. Interest on Rohan's drawings will be calculated for an average period of :

questions.text: पी, क्यू तथा आर एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 6:5:4 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे। उन्होंने फर्म के लाभों में 1/8 भाग के लिए एस को एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया। यह सहमति हुई कि क्यू अपना मूल भाग बनाए रखेगा। पी तथा आर का त्याग अनुपात होगा :
questions.text_english: P, Q and R were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 6:5:4. They admitted S as a new partner for 1/8th share in the profits of the firm. It was agreed that Q would retain his original share. The sacrificing ratio of P and R will be :
questions.solution: Option C is correct because since Q retains his original share and no other specific sacrificing ratios are given, the remaining partners P and R will sacrifice in their old profit sharing ratio with each other, which is six to four, simplifying to three to two.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि जब क्यू अपना मूल भाग बनाए रखता है और कोई अन्य जानकारी नहीं दी गई है, तो शेष साझेदार पी और आर अपने पुराने लाभ विभाजन अनुपात यानी 6:4 में त्याग करेंगे, जिसे सरल करने पर 3:2 प्राप्त होता है।

questions.text: रवि, सुनील तथा अमित एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4: 3:5 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2025 को रवि सेवानिवृत्त हो गया। सुनील तथा अमित ने भविष्य में लाभों को 2:3 के अनुपात में बाँटने का निर्णय लिया। सामान्य संचय, ख्याति तथा पुनर्मूल्यांकन, आदि के संबंध में सभी समायोजन करने के पश्चात् रवि, सुनील तथा अमित के पूँजी खातों में क्रमश: ₹ 3,00,000; ₹2,40,000 तथा ₹ 3,60,000 के शेष थे। यह निर्णय लिया गया कि रवि को देय राशि सुनील तथा अमित इस प्रकार लाएँगे कि उनकी पूँजी उनके नए लाभ विभाजन अनुपात में हो जाए। सुनील तथा अमित द्वारा लाई गई राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: Ravi, Sunil and Amit were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:5. On 1st April, 2025, Ravi retired. Sunil and Amit decided to share future profits in the ratio of 2: 3. After all adjustments with respect to general reserve, goodwill and revaluation, etc., the balances in the capital accounts of Ravi, Sunil and Amit stood at ₹3,00,000; ₹ 2,40,000 and ₹ 3,60,000 respectively. It was decided that the amount payable to Ravi will be brought by Sunil and Amit in such a way so as to make their capitals proportionate to their new profit sharing ratio. The amount brought in by Sunil and Amit will be :
questions.solution: Option B is correct because the total capital of the new firm will be the sum of adjusted capitals plus the amount to be paid to Ravi, which is two lakh forty thousand plus three lakh sixty thousand plus three lakh, giving nine lakh rupees. Dividing this in the new ratio of two to three gives required capitals of three lakh sixty thousand for Sunil and five lakh forty thousand for Amit. Sunil needs to bring in one lakh twenty thousand and Amit needs to bring in one lakh eighty thousand.

They admitted Kabir as a new partner for 1/5th share in the profits of the firm. Kabir brought ₹1,50,000 as his capital. Kabir's share in the goodwill of the firm was:
sub_questions.solution: Option B is correct because the total capitalized value based on Kabir's capital is seven lakh fifty thousand rupees. The total actual capital is six lakh fifty thousand rupees, revealing a hidden goodwill of one lakh rupees. Kabir's one-fifth share of this total goodwill is twenty thousand rupees.

sub_questions.solution: Option C is correct because the difference between the final settled amount and Ravi's adjusted capital is thirty thousand rupees, representing his share of the hidden goodwill. Since his share was four-eighths or one-half, the total goodwill of the firm is twice this amount, equalling sixty thousand rupees.

There is no partnership deed. Angad demands interest on loan @ 10% p.a. On 31st March, 2025, the amount of interest on loan due to Angad will be :
questions.solution: Option A is correct because in the absence of a partnership deed, the Indian Partnership Act prescribes an interest rate of six percent per annum on partner loans. Calculating six percent of eight lakh rupees for nine months gives thirty-six thousand rupees.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है क्योंकि साझेदारी संलेख के अभाव में, भारतीय साझेदारी अधिनियम के अनुसार साझेदार के ऋण पर 6% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज दिया जाता है। 8,00,000 रुपये पर 6% की दर से 9 महीने (1 जुलाई से 31 मार्च) का ब्याज 36,000 रुपये होता है।

questions.text: पिछले कुछ वर्षों में एक व्यवसाय ने ₹ 2,00,000 का औसत लाभ अर्जित किया । व्यवसाय की शुद्ध परिसम्पत्तियों का मूल्य ₹ 17,00,000 है तथा समान व्यवसाय में प्रतिफल की सामान्य दर 10% है। अधिलाभ की पूँजीकरण विधि द्वारा व्यवसाय की ख्याति का मूल्य होगा :
questions.text_english: A business earned an average profit of ₹ 2,00,000 during the last few years. The value of net assets of the business is ₹ 17,00,000 and the normal rate of return in a similar business is 10%. The value of goodwill of the business by capitalisation of super-profits method will be :
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the normal profit is ten percent of seventeen lakhs, which equals one lakh seventy thousand. Subtracting this from the average profit of two lakhs yields a super profit of thirty thousand rupees. Capitalising this super profit by multiplying by one hundred and dividing by ten results in a goodwill value of three lakh rupees.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि सामान्य लाभ 17,00,000 रुपये का 10% अर्थात 1,70,000 रुपये है। 2,00,000 रुपये के औसत लाभ में से इसे घटाने पर अधिलाभ 30,000 रुपये प्राप्त होता है। अधिलाभ का पूँजीकरण करने पर (30,000 × 100/10) ख्याति का मूल्य 3,00,000 रुपये होगा।

questions.text_english: Asha, Manan and Niyati were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:1. With effect from 1st April, 2025, they agreed to share profits and losses equally. Due to change in the profit sharing ratio, Asha's gain or sacrifice will be :
questions.solution: Option A is correct because the sacrifice is computed by subtracting the new share from the old share. Asha's old share was three-sixths, and her new share is one-third, which equates to two-sixths. The difference is one-sixth, indicating a sacrifice.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है क्योंकि त्याग निकालने के लिए पुराने भाग में से नया भाग घटाया जाता है। आशा का पुराना भाग 3/6 था और नया भाग 1/3 (अर्थात 2/6) है। इसलिए उसका त्याग 3/6 - 2/6 = 1/6 होगा।

questions.text: दिनेश, सिद्धार्थ तथा नैना एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 5 : 3 : 2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । 31 मार्च, 2025 को उन्होंने फर्म के विघटन का निर्णय लिया। इस तिथि को, फर्म के देनदार ₹2,10,000 थे तथा संदिग्ध ऋणों के लिए प्रावधान ₹20,000 था। विघटन पर ₹10,000 के देनदार डूब गए तथा शेष देनदारों से 90% प्राप्त हुआ। देनदारों से वसूली गई राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: Dinesh, Siddharth and Naina were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3: 2. On 31st March, 2025, they decided to dissolve the firm. On this date, the firm had debtors amounting to ₹ 2,10,000 and provision for doubtful debts of ₹ 20,000. On dissolution, debtors of ₹ 10,000 proved bad and the remaining debtors realised 90%. Amount realised from debtors will be :
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the bad debts of ten thousand are subtracted from the gross debtors of two lakh ten thousand, leaving two lakh rupees. Since the remaining debtors realise ninety percent, the firm collects ninety percent of two lakhs, equating to exactly one lakh eighty thousand rupees.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि कुल देनदार 2,10,000 रुपये थे, जिनमें से 10,000 रुपये डूब गए, जिससे शेष देनदार 2,00,000 रुपये बचे। इन शेष देनदारों से 90% राशि प्राप्त हुई, अतः वसूली गई कुल राशि 1,80,000 रुपये होगी।

questions.text: अमिक लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 70,000, 9% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 5% प्रीमियम पर किया, जिनका शोधन 10% प्रीमियम पर करना था। अमिक लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में 'ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन पर हानि खाता' कितनी राशि से डेबिट किया जाएगा ?
questions.text_english: Amik Ltd. issued 70,000, 9% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 5%, redeemable at a premium of 10%. 'Loss on Issue of Debentures Account' will be debited in the books of Amik Ltd. by:
questions.solution: Option B is correct because the 'Loss on Issue of Debentures Account' records the extra premium payable on redemption. Since they are redeemable at a ten percent premium, this amounts to ten rupees per debenture. Multiplying ten by seventy thousand debentures yields exactly seven lakh rupees.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है क्योंकि 'ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन पर हानि खाता' में केवल शोधन पर देय प्रीमियम को डेबिट किया जाता है। यहाँ शोधन 10% प्रीमियम पर होना है, जो 10 रुपये प्रति ऋणपत्र होता है। 70,000 ऋणपत्रों के लिए कुल हानि 7,00,000 रुपये होगी।

questions.text: अयाचित पूँजी का वह एक भाग जिसे कम्पनी द्वारा केवल कम्पनी के समापन की स्थिति में माँगे जाने के लिए आरक्षित किया होता है, कहलाता है :
questions.text_english: A portion of the uncalled capital reserved by a company to be called only in the event of winding up of the company is called :

options.A: अभिदत्त परन्तु पूर्ण प्रदत्त नहीं पूँजी

options_english.A: Subscribed but not fully paid capital

questions.solution: Option D is correct because Reserve Capital explicitly denotes that specific portion of a company's uncalled capital which has been legally restricted, through a special resolution, to be called up only in the event of the company's liquidation.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है क्योंकि आरक्षित पूँजी अयाचित पूँजी का वह विशेष भाग है जिसे कम्पनी द्वारा विशेष प्रस्ताव पारित करके केवल समापन की स्थिति में ही माँगने के लिए सुरक्षित किया जाता है।

questions.text_english: White Ltd. purchased Plant and Machinery worth ₹3,96,000 from Nath Ltd. The purchase consideration was paid by issue of 9% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at 10% discount. The number of debentures issued were :
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the number of debentures is determined by dividing the purchase consideration by the net issue price per debenture. With an issue price of ninety rupees per debenture, dividing three lakh ninety-six thousand by ninety yields exactly four thousand four hundred debentures.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि निर्गमित ऋणपत्रों की संख्या की गणना क्रय प्रतिफल को प्रति ऋणपत्र के निर्गमन मूल्य से विभाजित करके की जाती है। 3,96,000 रुपये को 90 रुपये (100 - 10% बट्टा) से विभाजित करने पर 4,400 ऋणपत्र आते हैं।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : ख्याति एक अमूर्त परिसम्पत्ति है।
कारण (R) : ख्याति किसी फर्म की लोकप्रियता का वह मूल्य है जो सामान्य लाभों की अपेक्षा भविष्य में अधिक लाभ अर्जित करने से सम्बन्धित है।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Goodwill is an intangible asset.
Reason (R): Goodwill is the value of the reputation of a firm in respect of profits expected in future over and above the normal profits.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.

questions.solution: Option A is correct because goodwill is indeed an intangible asset representing the firm's reputation and its resulting ability to earn super profits. The reason correctly explains what creates the value of this intangible asset.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है क्योंकि ख्याति वास्तव में एक अमूर्त परिसम्पत्ति है और इसका कारण भी सही है कि यह फर्म की प्रतिष्ठा का मूल्य है जिससे वह सामान्य से अधिक लाभ कमाती है। कारण, अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: अनीता तथा प्रियल एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटती थीं । 1 अप्रैल, 2024 को, उनके पूँजी खाते क्रमशः ₹ 3,00,000 तथा ₹ 4,00,000 का शेष दर्शा रहे थे। साझेदारी संलेख में पूँजी पर 8% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज का प्रावधान था। 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए फर्म ने ₹ 28,000 का लाभ अर्जित किया। अनीता तथा प्रियल को पूँजी पर दिया गया ब्याज था :
questions.text_english: Anita and Priyal were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3: 2. On 1st April, 2024, their capital accounts showed balances of ₹3,00,000 and ₹4,00,000 respectively. The partnership deed provided for interest on capital @ 8% p.a. The firm earned a profit of ₹ 28,000 for the year ended 31st March, 2025. Interest on capital allowed to Anita and Priyal was :
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the total interest on capital required is fifty-six thousand rupees (twenty-four thousand for Anita and thirty-two thousand for Priyal), which exceeds the available profit of twenty-eight thousand rupees. The available profit must be distributed in the ratio of their interest claims, which is three to four, giving twelve thousand to Anita and sixteen thousand to Priyal.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि पूँजी पर कुल आवश्यक ब्याज 56,000 रुपये है, जो 28,000 रुपये के उपलब्ध लाभ से अधिक है। इसलिए उपलब्ध लाभ को उनके ब्याज के दावों के अनुपात (24:32 या 3:4) में बाँटा जाएगा, जिससे अनीता को 12,000 रुपये और प्रियल को 16,000 रुपये प्राप्त होंगे।

questions.text: आरव, करण तथा मीरा एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा लाभ-हानि बराबर-बराबर बाँटते थे । 31 मार्च, 2023 को करण सेवानिवृत्त हो गया। सेवानिवृत्ति की तिथि पर, उसे ₹ 1,80,000 देय हुए। 31 मार्च, 2024 से शुरू करके आरव तथा मीरा, करण को दो बराबर वार्षिक किस्तों में अदत्त शेष राशि पर 12% वार्षिक ब्याज के साथ भुगतान करने पर सहमत हुए। फर्म अपनी पुस्तकें प्रति वर्ष 31 मार्च को बंद करती है। पूर्ण भुगतान किए जाने तक करण का ऋण खाता तैयार कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Aarav, Karan and Meera were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses equally. On 31st March, 2023, Karan retired. On the date of his retirement, ₹ 1,80,000 became due to him. Aarav and Meera agreed to pay Karan in two equal yearly instalments plus interest @ 12% p.a. on unpaid balance, starting from 31st March, 2024. The firm closes its books on 31st March every year. Prepare Karan's loan account till it is fully paid.

key_points: Record opening balance in Loan Account
Calculate interest for first year on unpaid balance
Record first instalment payment including interest
Calculate interest for second year
Record final instalment payment closing the account

questions.solution: In Karan's Loan Account, the opening balance of one lakh eighty thousand is credited on April 1, 2023. For the year ending March 31, 2024, interest is calculated at twelve percent on the full amount, which is twenty-one thousand six hundred rupees, and credited to the account. On the same date, the first instalment is paid, which comprises half the principal (ninety thousand) plus the interest (twenty-one thousand six hundred), totaling one lakh eleven thousand six hundred rupees, debited to the account. The remaining balance carried forward is ninety thousand rupees. For the year ending March 31, 2025, interest is calculated on the remaining ninety thousand, yielding ten thousand eight hundred rupees, which is credited. Finally, the second instalment of one lakh eight hundred rupees is paid and debited, reducing the account balance to zero.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.text_english: Attempt any one of the following:

sub_questions.text: 1 अक्टूबर, 2024 को रोहित, आशीष तथा समीर ने क्रमशः ₹ 12,00,000; ₹ 6,00,000 तथा ₹ 6,00,000 की पूँजी के साथ एक साझेदारी में प्रवेश किया। उन्होंने लाभ-हानि 3:1:1 के अनुपात में बाँटने का निर्णय लिया। साझेदारी संलेख के प्रावधानों के अनुसार साझेदार पूँजी पर 5% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज के हकदार थे। समीर को गारंटी दी गई थी कि पूँजी पर ब्याज प्रभारित करने के पश्चात् लाभ में उसका भाग प्रति वर्ष ₹ 1,50,000 से कम नहीं होगा। इस कारण हुई किसी भी कमी को रोहित द्वारा वहन किया जाएगा । 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए लाभ की राशि ₹5,60,000 थी। 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए लाभ-हानि विनियोजन खाता तैयार कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Rohit, Ashish and Sameer entered into a partnership on 1st October, 2024 with capitals of ₹ 12,00,000; ₹ 6,00,000 and ₹6,00,000 respectively. They decided to share the profits and losses in the ratio of 3:1: 1. Partners were entitled to interest on capital @5% per annum as per the provisions of the partnership deed. Sameer was given a guarantee that his share of profit, after charging interest on capital, will not be less than ₹ 1,50,000 per annum. Any deficiency arising on that account shall be met by Rohit. The profit for the year ended 31st March, 2025 amounted to ₹ 5,60,000. Prepare Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

key_points: Record Net Profit in P&L Appropriation Account
Calculate Interest on Capital for 6 months
Calculate distributable profit
Determine Sameer's guaranteed profit for 6 months
Adjust Rohit's share for the deficiency

sub_questions.solution: In the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account, credit the net profit of five lakh sixty thousand. Interest on capital is calculated for six months: Rohit gets thirty thousand, and Ashish and Sameer get fifteen thousand each. The remaining distributable profit is five lakh rupees. Sameer's guaranteed minimum is one lakh fifty thousand annually, equating to seventy-five thousand for the six-month period. His actual one-fifth share is one lakh. Since his actual share exceeds his guarantee, no deficiency arises. The final profit distribution credits Rohit with three lakhs, Ashish with one lakh, and Sameer with one lakh.

sub_questions.text: तारा, देव तथा ईशान एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 4:3:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । साझेदारी संलेख में आहरण पर 10% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज प्रभारित करने का प्रावधान था । 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में तारा, देव तथा ईशान के आहरण क्रमशः ₹ 30,000; ₹ 18,000 तथा ₹ 12,000 थे। अन्तिम खाते तैयार करने के पश्चात्, यह ज्ञात हुआ कि आहरणों पर ब्याज को ध्यान में नहीं रखा गया। चूक के सुधार के लिए आवश्यक समायोजन रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टि दीजिए। अपना कार्य स्पष्ट रूप से दर्शाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Tara, Dev and Ishaan were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:1. The partnership deed provided for charging interest on drawings @ 10% p.a. The drawings of Tara, Dev and Ishaan during the year ending 31st March, 2025 amounted to ₹30,000; ₹ 18,000 and ₹ 12,000 respectively. After the final accounts were prepared, it was discovered that interest on drawings was not taken into consideration. Give necessary adjusting journal entry to correct the omission. Show your workings clearly.

key_points: Calculate interest on drawings for 6 months (average period)
Identify total interest to be distributed as profit
Determine net adjustment for each partner
Pass the single adjustment journal entry

sub_questions.solution: Interest on drawings is calculated for an average period of six months since dates are not given. Tara's interest is one thousand five hundred, Dev's is nine hundred, and Ishaan's is six hundred, totaling three thousand rupees. This three thousand rupees represents unrecorded profit, which is distributed in the ratio four to three to one, crediting Tara one thousand five hundred, Dev one thousand one hundred twenty-five, and Ishaan three hundred seventy-five. The net effect leaves Tara nil, Dev with a credit of two hundred twenty-five, and Ishaan with a debit of two hundred twenty-five. The adjusting entry debits Ishaan's Capital Account and credits Dev's Capital Account with two hundred twenty-five rupees.

questions.text: संजना तथा मेहुल एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4 : 1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2025 से, उन्होंने भविष्य में लाभ-हानि 5 : 3 के अनुपात में बाँटने का निर्णय लिया । इस तिथि को, उनका स्थिति विवरण सामान्य संचय खाते में ₹ 40,000 का तथा लाभ-हानि खाते में ₹ 1.80,000 का डेबिट शेष दर्शा रहा था। साझेदारों ने सामान्य संचय को बाँटने का निर्णय लिया परन्तु लाभ-हानि खाते को प्रभावित न करने का निर्णय लिया, जो पुनर्गठित फर्म की पुस्तकों में चालू रहेगा। फर्म के पुनर्गठन पर उपर्युक्त लेनदेनों के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए । अपना कार्य स्पष्ट रूप से दर्शाइए ।
questions.text_english: Sanjana and Mehul were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4: 1. From 1st April, 2025, they decided to share future profits and losses in the ratio of 5: 3. On this date, their balance sheet showed a balance of ₹ 40,000 in General Reserve Account and a debit balance of ₹ 1,80,000 in the Profit and Loss Account. The partners decided to distribute the General Reserve, but decided not to disturb the Profit and Loss Account, which will continue in the books of the reconstituted firm. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions on the reconstitution of the firm. Show your workings clearly.

key_points: Distribute General Reserve in the old profit sharing ratio
Calculate Sacrificing and Gaining Ratio
Determine the adjustment amount for the Profit and Loss debit balance
Pass adjusting entry for the P&L debit balance

questions.solution: The first entry distributes the General Reserve by debiting the General Reserve Account with forty thousand rupees and crediting Sanjana's and Mehul's Capital Accounts with thirty-two thousand and eight thousand rupees respectively in their old ratio of four to one. Since the Profit and Loss debit balance of one lakh eighty thousand is to remain undisturbed, an adjustment entry is required. Sanjana's old share was four-fifths and new is five-eighths, resulting in a sacrifice of seven-fortieths. Mehul gains exactly seven-fortieths. The adjustment amount is seven-fortieths of one lakh eighty thousand, equalling thirty-one thousand five hundred rupees. For a loss, the gaining partner compensates the sacrificing partner. The entry debits Sanjana's Capital Account and credits Mehul's Capital Account with thirty-one thousand five hundred rupees.

questions.text_english: Attempt any one of the following:

sub_questions.text: सेंचुरी लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 5,000 अंश जिन्हें 40% प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित किया गया था, का ₹ 35 प्रति अंश की आबंटन राशि तथा ₹50 प्रति अंश (₹ 25 प्रीमियम सहित) की प्रथम याचना का भुगतान न करने पर हरण कर लिया। ₹ 40 प्रति अंश (₹ 15 प्रीमियम सहित) की दूसरी तथा अन्तिम याचना अभी तक माँगी नहीं गई थी। इनमें से, 3,000 अंशों को ₹ 90 प्रति अंश पूर्ण प्रदत्त पुनः निर्गमित कर दिया गया। सेंचुरी लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में अंशों के हरण तथा हरण किए गए अंशों के पुनःनिर्गमन की आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Century Ltd. forfeited 5,000 shares of ₹ 100 each issued at 40% premium for non-payment of allotment money of ₹35 per share and first call of ₹ 50 per share (including premium ₹ 25). The second and final call of ₹ 40 per share (including premium ₹ 15) has not yet been called. Out of these, 3,000 shares were reissued as fully paid-up for ₹90 per share. Pass necessary journal entries for forfeiture and reissue of forfeited shares in the books of Century Ltd.

key_points: Determine called up capital and premium not received
Record forfeiture entry
Record reissue of shares at a discount
Transfer gain on reissue to Capital Reserve

sub_questions.solution: The total premium is forty rupees. Since fifteen rupees premium is uncalled, the called-up premium is twenty-five. The uncalled capital is twenty-five rupees, so the called-up capital is seventy-five. The forfeiture entry debits Share Capital with three lakh seventy-five thousand and Securities Premium with one lakh twenty-five thousand. It credits Share Allotment with one lakh seventy-five thousand, Share First Call with two lakh fifty thousand, and Share Forfeiture with seventy-five thousand. On reissuing three thousand shares at ninety, Bank is debited with two lakh seventy thousand, Share Forfeiture with thirty thousand, and Share Capital is credited with three lakhs. Finally, the gain transferred to Capital Reserve is calculated by multiplying the twenty-five rupee per share original forfeiture by three thousand, minus the thirty thousand discount, resulting in forty-five thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: आलमंड लिमिटेड ने कैशू लिमिटेड का एक चालू व्यवसाय ₹ 1,00,00,000 के क्रय प्रतिफल में खरीदा जिसमें ₹ 85,00,000 की भूमि तथा भवन, ₹ 50,00,000 की मशीनरी तथा ₹ 10,00,000 की विविध देयताएँ सम्मिलित थीं। ₹ 10,00,000 का भुगतान चैक द्वारा तथा शेष राशि का भुगतान ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 11% ऋणपत्रों को 20% प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित करके किया गया। आलमंड लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में उपर्युक्त लेनदेनों के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Almond Ltd. purchased a running business of Cashew Ltd. comprising of land and building ₹ 85,00,000, machinery ₹ 50,00,000 and sundry liabilities ₹10,00,000 for a purchase consideration of ₹ 1,00,00,000. Payment of ₹10,00,000 was made through a cheque and the remaining amount by issue of 11% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 20%. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Almond Ltd.

key_points: Record asset and liability acquisition determining Goodwill/Capital Reserve
Record partial payment through bank
Calculate number of debentures issued at a premium
Record issue of debentures to settle purchase consideration

sub_questions.solution: The first entry records the purchase by debiting Land and Building Account with eighty-five lakhs and Machinery Account with fifty lakhs. Since the net assets acquired are one crore twenty-five lakhs and the purchase consideration is one crore, the balancing figure of twenty-five lakhs is credited to Capital Reserve Account, while crediting Sundry Liabilities with ten lakhs and Cashew Ltd with one crore. Next, Cashew Ltd is debited with one crore. The Bank Account is credited with ten lakhs for the cheque payment. The remaining ninety lakhs is settled by issuing debentures at one hundred twenty rupees each, totaling seventy-five thousand debentures. The 11% Debentures Account is credited with the face value of seventy-five lakhs, and Securities Premium Account is credited with fifteen lakhs.

questions.text: 1 अप्रैल, 2024 को स्मरण लिमिटेड ने ₹100 प्रत्येक के 60,000, 11% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 10% प्रीमियम पर किया, जिनका शोधन पाँच वर्ष पश्चात् सममूल्य पर करना था। कम्पनी अपनी पुस्तकें प्रति वर्ष 31 मार्च को बंद करती है। 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए कम्पनी की पुस्तकों में ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन, ऋणपत्रों पर ब्याज के भुगतान तथा ब्याज को अपलिखित करने की आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए।
questions.text_english: On 1st April, 2024, Smaran Ltd. issued 60,000, 11% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 10%, redeemable at par after five years. The company closed its books on 31st March every year. Pass necessary journal entries in the books of the company for issue of debentures, payment of interest on debentures and writing off interest for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

key_points: Record receipt of application and allotment money with premium
Record issue of debentures transferring to Debentures and Securities Premium Account
Calculate and record interest due on debentures at year-end
Record payment of debenture interest
Transfer debenture interest expense to Statement of Profit and Loss

questions.solution: On April 1, 2024, the Bank Account is debited and Debenture Application and Allotment Account is credited with sixty-six lakh rupees, representing the face value and ten percent premium. The allotment entry debits Debenture Application and Allotment Account with sixty-six lakhs, crediting 11% Debentures Account with sixty lakhs and Securities Premium Account with six lakhs. At the end of the year on March 31, 2025, the interest must be calculated on the face value. Eleven percent of sixty lakhs is six lakh sixty thousand rupees. Debenture Interest Account is debited and Debentureholders Account is credited with six lakh sixty thousand. The payment is recorded by debiting Debentureholders Account and crediting Bank Account with the same amount. Finally, the interest expense is written off by debiting the Statement of Profit and Loss and crediting Debenture Interest Account with six lakh sixty thousand rupees.

questions.text:
अनमोल, कपीश तथा मीरा एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4 : 3 : 3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे। फर्म अपनी पुस्तकें प्रति वर्ष 31 मार्च को बंद करती है। 1 जुलाई, 2025 को कपीश की मृत्यु हो गई। उस तिथि को उसका पूँजी खाता ₹ 2,50,000 का क्रेडिट शेष दर्शा रहा था तथा उसने व्यक्तिगत उपयोग के लिए आज की तिथि तक ₹ 20,000 का आहरण किया था। कपीश की मृत्यु की तिथि को, फर्म के पास ₹ 90,000 का सामान्य संचय था। साझेदारी संलेख में प्रावधान था कि एक साझेदार की मृत्यु पर उसके निष्पादक निम्नलिखित के हकदार होंगे :
(i) उसके पूँजी खाते में शेष तथा उस पर 12% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज ।
(ii) फर्म की ख्याति में उसका भाग। कपीश की मृत्यु पर फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 1,40,000 किया गया।
(iii) फर्म के लाभों में उसके भाग की गणना पिछले वर्ष के लाभ के आधार पर की जाएगी ।
31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए फर्म का लाभ ₹ 6,00,000 था। उसके निष्पादकों को प्रस्तुत करने के लिए कपीश का पूँजी खाता तैयार कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Anmol, Kapeesh and Meera were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:3. The firm closes its books on 31st March every year. On 1st July, 2025, Kapeesh died. On that date his capital account showed a credit balance of ₹ 2,50,000 and he had withdrawn ₹ 20,000 till that date for personal use. On the date of Kapeesh's death, the firm had a General Reserve of ₹ 90,000. The partnership deed provided that on the death of a partner, his executors will be entitled to the following:
(i) Balance in the capital account and interest on the same @ 12% p.a.
(ii) His share in the goodwill of the firm. The goodwill of the firm on Kapeesh's death was valued at ₹ 1,40,000.
(iii) His share in the profits of the firm was to be calculated on the basis of previous year's profit.
The profit of the firm for the year ended 31st March, 2025 was ₹ 6,00,000. Prepare Kapeesh's Capital Account to be presented to his executors.

key_points: Record opening Capital balance
Calculate and record Interest on Capital for 3 months
Record share of General Reserve
Calculate and record share of Goodwill
Calculate and record share of Profit till date of death
Record Drawings on debit side
Determine final amount to be transferred to Executor's Account

questions.solution: In Kapeesh's Capital Account, the credit side will display his opening capital balance of two lakh fifty thousand rupees. The interest on his capital for the three months until his death is calculated at twelve percent, which equals seven thousand five hundred rupees. His share of the general reserve is three-tenths of ninety thousand, giving twenty-seven thousand rupees. For goodwill, his three-tenths share of one lakh forty thousand is forty-two thousand rupees, which is credited to him by debiting Anmol and Meera in their gaining ratio of four to three. His share of profit for three months based on the previous year's six lakhs is forty-five thousand rupees, credited via Profit & Loss Suspense. On the debit side, his drawings of twenty thousand rupees are recorded. The final balancing figure to be transferred to Kapeesh's Executors Account is three lakh fifty-one thousand five hundred rupees.

questions.text:
ब्राइट मोटर्स लिमिटेड ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के समता अंशों में विभक्त ₹ 10,00,00,000 की अधिकृत पूँजी के साथ पंजीकृत थी। कम्पनी ने जनता के अभिदान के लिए 3,00,000 अंश निर्गमित किए। राशि का भुगतान निम्न प्रकार से देय था :
आवेदन पर - ₹30 प्रति अंश
आबंटन पर - ₹ 50 प्रति अंश
प्रथम एवं अन्तिम याचना पर – शेष
सभी अंश पूर्ण अभिदत्त थे । सभी राशियाँ यथावत प्राप्त हो गईं, केवल रमन को छोड़कर, जो 500 अंशों का धारक था, तथा जो प्रथम एवं अन्तिम याचना का भुगतान करने में असफल रहा।
निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Bright Motors Ltd. was registered with an authorised capital of ₹10,00,00,000 divided into equity shares of ₹ 100 each. The company issued 3,00,000 shares to the public for subscription. The amount was payable as follows:
On application - ₹30 per share
On allotment - ₹50 per share
On first and final call - balance
All the shares were fully subscribed. All amounts were duly received except from Raman, a holder of 500 shares, who failed to pay the first and final call.
Answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: अंशों की वह कुल संख्या जिसमें कम्पनी की अधिकृत अंश पूँजी विभक्त है, है :
sub_questions.text_english: Total number of shares into which the authorised share capital of the company is divided, is :
sub_questions.solution: Option C is correct because the authorised capital is ten crore rupees divided into shares of one hundred rupees each. Dividing ten crore by one hundred gives exactly ten lakh shares.

sub_questions.text: ब्राइट मोटर्स लिमिटेड की 'अभिदत्त तथा पूर्ण प्रदत्त पूँजी' की राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: Amount of 'Subscribed and fully paid-up capital' of Bright Motors Ltd. will be :
sub_questions.solution: Option A is correct because out of the three lakh shares subscribed, five hundred shares failed to pay fully. The remaining two lakh ninety-nine thousand five hundred shares are fully paid at one hundred rupees each, amounting to two crore ninety-nine lakh fifty thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: ब्राइट मोटर्स लिमिटेड की 'अभिदत्त परन्तु पूर्ण प्रदत्त नहीं पूँजी' की राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: Amount of 'Subscribed but not fully paid-up capital' of Bright Motors Ltd. will be :
sub_questions.solution: Option D is correct because the five hundred shares that defaulted represent fifty thousand rupees in called-up capital. Deducting the ten thousand rupees unpaid final call leaves a net paid amount of forty thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: ब्राइट मोटर्स लिमिटेड के स्थिति विवरण में प्रस्तुत की जाने वाली 'अंश पूँजी' की राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: Amount of 'Share Capital' to be presented in the Balance Sheet of Bright Motors Ltd. will be :
sub_questions.solution: Option C is correct because the balance sheet reflects the sum of fully paid capital and not fully paid capital. Adding two crore ninety-nine lakh fifty thousand and forty thousand yields two crore ninety-nine lakh ninety thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: यदि भुगतान न करने वाले 500 अंशों का हरण कर लिया जाए, तब 'खातों के नोट्स' में 'अंश हरण खाता' दर्शाया जाएगा :
sub_questions.text_english: If the defaulting 500 shares are forfeited, 'Share Forfeiture Account' will be shown in the 'Notes to Accounts' at:
sub_questions.solution: Option B is correct because the Share Forfeiture Account reflects the actual amount received on the forfeited shares. The shareholder paid eighty rupees per share on five hundred shares, equating to forty thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: यदि हरण किए गए सभी अंशों को ₹ 90 प्रति अंश पूर्ण प्रदत्त पुनः निर्गमित कर दिया जाए, तब पूँजी संचय खाते में क्रेडिट की गई राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: If all the forfeited shares are reissued @₹90 per share fully paid-up, the amount credited to Capital Reserve Account will be :
sub_questions.solution: Option A is correct because the total forfeited amount is forty thousand rupees. Reissuing five hundred shares at a ten rupee discount requires five thousand rupees to be debited from Share Forfeiture. Subtracting this from the forty thousand leaves a net gain of thirty-five thousand rupees to be transferred to Capital Reserve.

sub_questions.text:
अर्जुन तथा काव्या एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 3 : 2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । 31 मार्च, 2025 को उनका स्थिति विवरण निम्न प्रकार था :
...
1 अप्रैल, 2025 को निम्नलिखित शर्तों पर राघव को लाभों में 1/4 भाग के लिए एक नए साझेदार के रूप में फर्म में प्रवेश दिया गया :
(i) राघव अपनी पूँजी के रूप में ₹ 5,00,000 लाएगा।
(ii) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹4,00,000 किया गया। राघव ख्याति प्रीमियम का अपना भाग नगद में नहीं ला सका।
(iii) संदिग्ध ऋणों के लिए देनदारों पर 10% का प्रावधान करना था।
(iv) निवेशों का मूल्यांकन ₹2,00,000 किया गया तथा भवन को ₹ 5,00,000 तक नीचे लाया गया।
(v) अर्जुन तथा काव्या की पूँजी का समायोजन व्यवसाय में राघव की पूँजी के आधार पर किया जाना था । स्थिति अनुसार आवश्यक वास्तविक नगद पुराने साझेदारों को भुगतान किया जाना था अथवा उनके द्वारा लाया जाएगा।
पुनर्मूल्यांकन खाता तथा साझेदारों के पूँजी खाते तैयार कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
Arjun and Kavya were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3: 2. Their Balance Sheet as at 31st March, 2025 was as follows:
...
On 1st April, 2025, Raghav was admitted as a new partner for 1/4th share in the profits of the firm on the following terms:
(i) Raghav shall bring ₹5,00,000 as his capital.
(ii) Goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹4,00,000. Raghav was unable to bring his share of goodwill premium in cash.
(iii) Provision for doubtful debts was to be created @ 10% on debtors.
(iv) Investments were valued at ₹2,00,000 and building was to be brought down to ₹5,00,000.
(v) Capitals of Arjun and Kavya were to be adjusted on the basis of Raghav's capital in the business. Actual cash was to be paid off or brought in by the old partners as the case may be.
Prepare Revaluation Account and Partners' Capital Accounts.

key_points: Prepare Revaluation Account identifying all losses and profit/loss transfer
Pass Goodwill adjustment via new partner's Current Account
Adjust Investment Fluctuation Reserve
Calculate new capital structure based on Raghav's capital
Record cash adjustments for the old partners

sub_questions.solution: The Revaluation Account is debited with a nine thousand increase in the provision for doubtful debts and one lakh for the depreciation of the building. This yields a total revaluation loss of one lakh nine thousand, which is transferred to Arjun's and Kavya's Capital Accounts in their old ratio, debiting sixty-five thousand four hundred and forty-three thousand six hundred respectively. For the investments, the value fell by eighty thousand, which is absorbed by the one lakh Investment Fluctuation Reserve, leaving twenty thousand to be distributed to Arjun and Kavya as twelve thousand and eight thousand respectively. Raghav's share of goodwill is one lakh, adjusted by debiting his Current Account and crediting Arjun and Kavya sixty thousand and forty thousand respectively. Given Raghav brings five lakhs for a one-fourth share, the total capital is twenty lakhs. The new target capitals are nine lakhs for Arjun, six lakhs for Kavya, and five lakhs for Raghav. Comparing target capitals with adjusted actuals, Arjun has a deficiency of four lakh thirteen thousand four hundred and Kavya has a deficiency of seventy-five thousand six hundred, both of which they must bring in via cash to match their target balances.

sub_questions.text:
आरव, कुनाल तथा मानव एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे। 31 मार्च, 2025 को उनका स्थिति विवरण निम्न प्रकार था :
...
उपर्युक्त तिथि को आरव सेवानिवृत्त हो गया तथा इस पर सहमति हुई कि :
(i) कुनाल तथा मानव भविष्य के लाभों को 1 : 4 के अनुपात में बाँटेंगे।
(ii) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 6,00,000 किया जाएगा तथा सेवानिवृत्त साझेदार के भाग का समायोजन शेष साझेदारों के पूँजी खातों के माध्यम से किया जाएगा।
(iii) ₹20,000 के एक अलिखित लेनदार का लेखा किया जाएगा।
(iv) ₹15,000 के देनदारों को डूबत ऋणों के रूप में अपलिखित किया जाएगा।
(v) कामगार क्षतिपूर्ति के खाते पर देयता ₹ 40,000 थी।
(vi) आरव को देय राशि का हस्तांतरण उसके ऋण खाते में कर दिया गया।

Record settlement of creditors with stock and cash at discount
Record asset taken over by partner
Record cash realizations for debtors and machinery
Record realisation expenses paid by a partner
Calculate and distribute final Realisation Loss

questions.solution: In the Realisation Account, debit all assets (excluding cash): Machinery twelve lakhs, Investments seven lakhs, Debtors ten lakhs, and Stock four lakhs. Credit liabilities: Bank Loan seven lakhs and Creditors thirteen lakhs. Half the creditors (six lakh fifty thousand) take over the full stock; no entry is passed for this exchange. The Bank Account is debited for asset realisations: Debtors eight lakh fifty thousand and Machinery eight lakh forty thousand, totaling sixteen lakh ninety thousand. Realisation expenses of one lakh twenty thousand paid by Arhan are credited to his Capital Account. The account shows a total debit of forty-six lakh forty thousand against a credit of forty-five lakh thirty thousand, leaving a net realisation loss of one lakh ten thousand rupees, distributed to Arhan and Kanak as sixty-six thousand and forty-four thousand respectively.

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।

options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.

questions.solution: Option A is correct because for a finance company, borrowing and lending are core business operations, so interest paid is an operating outflow. However, for a non-financial enterprise, paying dividends is always classified as a financing activity, making Statement II false.

questions.solution: Assuming that the Total Income is located in cell B1 and the Expenses are located in cell B2, the core condition revolves around the net difference between them. The exact formula syntax to be entered via the Formula dialog box is: =IF((B1-B2)>50000, (B1-B2)*20%, (B1-B2)*10%). The result statement explains the logic explicitly: The system evaluates the logical test to check if the net amount (Income minus Expenses) exceeds fifty thousand rupees. If this condition proves true, the spreadsheet will calculate and display exactly twenty percent of that net amount. Conversely, if the net amount is fifty thousand rupees or less, the condition evaluates to false, and the spreadsheet will instead calculate and display precisely ten percent of the net amount.
